title: SCP Scorecard Emit (per-repo)
description: Per-repo scorecard emit produced by the opt-in `scorecard-emit: true` workflow_call input on the SCP federation primitive's reusable workflow. Defines the aggregated metrics that adopters publish for cross-repo scorecard aggregation per WP-SCP-023. NEVER carries waiver content (reason / approved_by / waiver_id) — only counts + rule_id keys per WP-SCP-023 plan-doc invariant 2. Verified at the aggregator side via GitHub Actions Artifact Attestation (OIDC-based via `gh attestation verify --signer-workflow`); no in-payload signature field — platform-level attestation is the trust anchor (per WP-SCP-023 §5 step 3 + D-042 to be filed at slice 023C). Schema versioning: MAJOR-pinned per `policies/VERSIONING.md` (D-036) + WP-SCP-023 plan-doc §10 Q1.

schema_version.description: Schema version (MAJOR-pinned). Aggregator drops emits with unknown schema_version.

emitted_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the emit was produced.

scp_version.description: SCP federation primitive version pin in effect for this evaluation. Read from the pinned `version-manifest.json` (the manifest at the wrapper's SHA pin), NOT from main HEAD. Format: semver `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.

ref.description: Git ref the evaluation ran against (branch or tag).

commit.description: Head SHA the evaluation ran against (40-char lowercase hex).

verdict.description: Aggregate verdict — allow if no effective denies; deny if any effective deny; warn if only warn-baseline rules fired.

rule_counts.description: Per-rule counts for every SCP-R-NNN rule that produced output. Keys are rule_ids (SCP-R-NNN). Rules with zero raw findings AND zero rule-config disable MAY be omitted (empty object means rule not exercised).

raw_findings.description: Number of raw findings produced by the rule before suppression (counts pre-waiver / pre-rule-config).

denies.description: Number of effective denies after suppression (post-waiver, post-rule-config). For warn-baseline rules: always 0.

waived.description: Number of raw findings suppressed by an active matching waiver.

rule_config_disabled.description: True iff `.scp/rule-config.yaml` has `rules.<rule_id>.disable: true` for this rule.

waivers_aggregate.description: Aggregated counts of active waivers in `output/findings/waivers.json`. NEVER carries waiver content — only counts and rule_id keys per WP-SCP-023 plan-doc invariant 2.

active_count.description: Total count of waiver entries with non-expired `expires_at`.

by_rule_id.description: Per-rule_id count of active waivers. Keys are rule_ids (SCP-R-NNN); values are counts. Empty object if no active waivers exist.

expiring_within_30d.description: Count of active waivers whose `expires_at` is within the next 30 days from `emitted_at`. Surfaces upcoming review burden.

rule_config_aggregate.description: Aggregated `.scp/rule-config.yaml` state. NEVER carries justification text — only rule_ids and counts.

disabled_rules.description: List of rule_ids with `disable: true`. Order is canonical (sorted ascending).

expiring_within_30d.description: Count of rule-config disable entries whose `expires_at` is within the next 30 days from `emitted_at`.
